title: Cuban Missile Crisis
description:
The **Cuban Missile Crisis** in October 1962 brought the world to the brink of nuclear war when the Soviet Union placed missiles in Cuba.

President Kennedy demanded their removal and blockaded Cuba. After 13 tense days, Khrushchev agreed to remove the missiles in exchange for US promises not to invade Cuba.

It was the closest the Cold War came to escalating into nuclear conflict.
